title: Blackbox: Integrations
summary: Cross-check fragments with records, maps, missions, and recovery plans before acting.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: SignalOS, Terminal, Wiki, and TutorialCore are the natural support surfaces. Index can expose records when the owning systems publish them.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use Terminal for recovered records, SignalOS for data surfaces, Wiki for spoiler-light summaries, and TutorialCore for reminders after risky interactions.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: Without linked records or mission surfaces, treat every directive as a note to verify. Mark the site, bring a spare kit, and leave room to retreat.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
